model_interpretation.claim: Replacing the baseline's four-wide X pencils with 32 contiguous X lanes should reduce poorly utilized global-memory transactions. A 16-row Y output tile shares 24 cooperatively loaded rows, including explicitly wrapped halos, across two outputs per thread. The larger tile also adds halo loads and shared-memory work, so any timing benefit is uncertain and must be measured against the 3.5815 µs baseline after oracle validation.

items.subject: Coalesced shared-memory Y tiles with explicit periodic halos
items.objective: In src/candidate.cu, investigate a single shared-memory tiled kernel that loads Y neighborhoods cooperatively with contiguous X lanes and reuses the tile across multiple Y outputs. Explore tile heights and launch shapes while ensuring every required halo is initialized. Match the supplied boundary convention for each neighbor coordinate q=j+d: add 63 if q<0, subtract 63 if q>63, otherwise leave q unchanged; preserve in-range index 63 and do not assume endpoint planes are equal. Preserve the exact stencil, full output, input buffers, and scratch rules. Validate against the oracle on signed varying inputs, including independent endpoint values, then compare repeated official full-run timings with the baseline.
